acceptance.evidence: gen-p1.mjs (own oracle: path.win32.resolve + own protected regexes), 400 cases: 33 fail-open, 32 confirmed in real Git Bash (truth-p1-cand.json). probe-holes.mjs/probe-holes2.mjs add 21 fail-open spellings, all confirmed in real bash: shell keywords then/do/!/{ } and timeout, nice -n, env -u, find -exec (D1); backslash before an ordinary character and backslash-newline (D2); cp -tDIR, -vt DIR, --target DIR (D3); /dev/../<repo>/open-brain/src (D4); env --chdir / env -C (D5); heredoc fed to bash, pipe to sh, sed w, a comment opening a fake heredoc (D6).

128 generated allow-cases: 1 denied with no named cause (a trailing '# done' read as tee targets resolves into open-brain/src). Probes: 'echo x # > open-brain/src/x.ts' (writes nothing) and unquoted 'echo x > open-brain\src\x.ts' (bash writes open-brainsrcx.ts in the root) are both denied as PH-1 writes with no stated cause (D7).
80 of 80 generated non-literal targets (~, ~user, $, ${}, $( ), backtick, * ? [, { }, $TMPDIR, 8 contexts) refused with a named cause. Edit/Write: 54 of 54 agree with the oracle.

gen-p2.mjs, 380 cases: 9 fail-open (5 foreign pull URLs, 4 '#N' refs), 45 fail-closed (38 non-merges with the word merge swept in, 7 exact merges with a trailing comment). probe-merge-async.mjs (fake fetch, all PRs docs-only): 'gh pr merge #2' allowed after reading PR 2 though bash and PowerShell drop #2 and gh merges the current branch's PR (D8); 'gh pr merge https://github.com/other/repo/pull/3' fetched from other/repo and allowed (D9). Allowed with no read: gh pr m\erge 2, gh pr \<newline>merge 2, gh pr $'merge' 2, gh pr {merge,} 2, X=merge; gh pr $X 2, gh $(echo pr) merge 2; real bash hands gh [pr, merge, 2] each time (D10). PowerShell '& gh' and '.\gh.exe' are read (met).

gen-p2b.mjs, 316 cases: 9 fail-open, all inline -c alias.X=merge|tag|'push --force origin master' (real git ran the merge) (D11); 6 fail-closed (trailing comment). Grant exactness 16 of 16. probe-holes2.mjs: git mer\ge, git {merge,}, git \<newline>merge, git pu\sh --force origin master allowed; real bash runs merge / push --force (D12).

Matcher Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash|PowerShell (met). gen-p3.mjs, 360 cases: 96 fail-open, 83 confirmed in real PowerShell 5.1 (truth-p3-cand.json; the 13 others are oracle errors on -LP/-Pa or setup). Classes: common parameters taking a value (-EA, -OV, -OB, -InfA, -PV, -EV, -WA) and the alias -Type (D13); ( ... ) targets, splatting, quoted comma list (D14); FileSystem:: provider paths and drive-relative C:path (D15); <##>, [scriptblock]::Create, positional powershell, -EncodedCommand, -Comman, [IO.File]::WriteAllText, alias inside a script block (D16).
